items.title: Kent Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: Orrin Keepnews helped me produce it

ctx.x: I’ll have to get that to you, I’m sorry I didn’t bring any of that music with me because I was really just concentrating on what I had to do here. Yeah I did it and it was a really, I think probably like some of the best playing in terms of what I wanted to convey. And obviously we did “Out of this World” that was influenced by John Coltrane. It’s not his composition but we — I say we — but Elton Herron who is a great colleague and a friend and a relative, arranged it for me and it’s just one of those things, one…

after the tape started rolling I gave everything I could give at that moment. And then I had to go on to something else. And with the recording industry changing now you really sort of have to pick your moments when you want to go in and do something that’s of value versus let me go into the studio and do a CD because I don’t want people to forget about me. I don’t really operate like that. You know, just come up with some tunes. For me it’s kind of a process and then when I’m there I’ll go yes, let’s go in and…
